current.text: Portland traded for him this offseason. He joins a crowded backcourt with Damian Lillard, Jrue Holiday, Deni Avdija and Scoot Henderson.
He is projected to start next to Lillard. Portland plans to stagger the two but still close games with both.
His usage should fall by almost 5 points from the 33% he had in Memphis. His assists are unlikely to hold at 8 per game while he shares the ball with Lillard, Holiday, Avdija and Scoot.
Portland's poor finishers (Camara, Clingan, Avdija) hurt how many of the guards' passes turn into assists.
Experts call his fit in Portland weird. They say he mutes the strengths of Lillard and Avdija.
Minutes and usage across the Portland rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
Do not draft him at his ESPN ADP of 50. He should still play enough minutes to beat his Yahoo rank of 103.
Tier 8 point guard on his median outcome. He has unlikely upside to average 24 points and 9 assists or to play 65 games.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: He is a high usage guard with strong assists. Even in limited games he piles up assists.
He is a poor shooter from the field and from three, and he does not move off the ball. His free throw shooting is now a strength.
Turnovers are his worst category and a clear weakness against the whole league.
He is not a good category player and his fantasy game is not robust. He is worth more in points leagues.
He can't stay healthy and has durability concerns.
His athleticism has declined. He is described as terrible on defense.
He has off-court problems and was suspended by his own team.

note: He cost 17 USD in our league last season, but the sites now price him near 3 to 5 USD (Yahoo rank 93, ESPN rank 133). That makes him a cheap late flyer in a 144-player draft, but do not pay anything close to last year's price. The assists, points and good FT% help, but about 3.4 turnovers per game and a below-average FG% fit a punt TO build best. Early on, check his usage and assists next to Lillard: Yahoo projects only 5.7 assists on 13 shots, while ESPN projects 7.2 on 16. Also check whether he stays healthy.
